_about: Photo slots. Add a real photo with: python3 tools/add-photo.py SOURCE.jpg SLOT --alt "..." --credit "Photographer, Source". A slot shows its photo only when the file exists; otherwise the illustration stays. See README, Photos. Optional "pos" sets object-position (x% y%) so the subject is not cropped, for example "50% 30%".
